answer: If I had gone, I would have met her.
I didn't go.
If I hadn't gone, I wouldn't have met her.
I went.
If I went, I would meet her.
I probably won't go.
he said he couldn't come because he was ill

he said he was ill because he couldn't come
because he said he was ill he couldn't come
